detail: The independent auditor's report on the Bank of Botswana's annual financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, addressed to the shareholder of the Bank of Botswana, is on EY letterhead giving an address at Plot 22, Khama Crescent, Gaborone, and gives an unmodified opinion. The Board approved the statements on 27 March 2026. The auditor's pages are scanned images that carry no machine-readable text, so this was read from the rendered page.
source_title: Annual Report 2025, independent auditor's report (Bank of Botswana)
